narrative.intro: This ranking shows which federal contract markets have risen the fastest year over year during FY2027 to date, based on contract obligations. The table covers ten industries and reports the year-over-year percent change in obligations. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences leads the list with 484.0% growth. The dataset covers partial-year totals; total contract obligations recorded so far for FY2027 to date are $12.3B. Other large gains include Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at 172.6%, Remediation Services at 165.7%, and Facilities Support Services at 153.3%. The ranking also lists Computer Systems Design Services at 52.4% and Temporary Help Services at 24.5%. Readers should treat the numbers as year-to-date changes, not full fiscal-year totals, because current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date).

sections.heading: Which industries show the largest year-over-year gains?
sections.body: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences shows the largest gain at 484.0%. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) follows at 172.6%, and Remediation Services follows at 165.7%. Facilities Support Services and Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) show 153.3% and 106.1% growth respectively.

sections.heading: How should buyers and sellers treat these FY2027-to-date figures?
sections.body: The figures report year-over-year percent changes in contract obligations for the same period of the fiscal year and therefore reflect partial-year activity. Total obligations recorded so far for FY2027 to date are $12.3B. Use the percentages to compare momentum across markets, not to infer full-year outcomes.

faq.q: What are the fastest-growing federal contract markets?
faq.a: The fastest-growing federal contract markets are Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (484.0%), Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) (172.6%), Remediation Services (165.7%), Facilities Support Services (153.3%), Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) (106.1%), Computer Systems Design Services (52.4%), Nonferrous Metal (except Aluminum) Smelting and Refining (47.8%), Couriers and Express Delivery Services (39.8%), Security Guards and Patrol Services (25.3%), and Temporary Help Services (24.5%). These figures are year-over-year percent changes in contract obligations for the same fiscal period. The list orders markets by percent growth during FY2027 to date.

faq.q: How is market growth measured here?
faq.a: Market growth is measured as year-over-year percent change in contract obligations for the same period of the fiscal year. The percentage values next to each market show that change. Current-year totals are partial because the figures cover FY2027 to date, and total obligations so far are $12.3B.
